summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting an ordinary share repurchase completed on 5 May 2026. Under a standing buyback arrangement with JP Morgan Securities plc announced on 6 January 2026, the company repurchased 351,312 shares at an average price of 10.9357 GBP (range 10.63–11.055 GBP). The shares will be cancelled, reducing outstanding count to 2,519,501,455. The buyback operates as an on-exchange purchase under London Stock Exchange and Hong Kong rules. Watch for continued execution of the authorization from the 2025 AGM; risk-arb here is minimal as this is an open-market issuer repurchase.
